summary: Reviewed the whole lessons module (player, navigation, try slot, safe visual, 22 visuals, tests, gallery) against src/types, the content lessons w1–w8, and the activity host contract. Fixed the real defects I found: a missing final carry in column addition, a no-op expression in the 5+1 visual, a test blind spot that let a crashing visual pass silently, and a too-small gallery card. Lesson tests and the filtered typecheck are clean. Still open: visual labels are not routed through host.t, and I did not capture the real routes or all portrait/landscape screens.
publicApi: LessonPlayer default export with props { lesson, onDone, onExit? } unchanged. LESSON_VISUALS and LESSON_VISUAL_IDS in visuals/index.tsx unchanged. Re-exported from src/activities/index.tsx.
tests: npx vitest run src/activities/lesson: 3 files, 65 passed, 0 failed (after the fixes). npm run typecheck filtered on activities/lesson: 0 errors. Gallery captured: shots/lesson-gallery-ipad.png (before the gallery card resize). Maths of all 22 visuals and the w1–w8 lesson texts were checked by hand against their params (e.g. 352−127, 503−128, 4352−1728, 47×6, 84÷4, 17÷5, 7×9, 8-table and 6-table known facts); no wrong numbers found.
openIssues: Visual labels in src/activities/lesson/visuals/*.tsx are literal Spanish strings, not host.t(). Only a few need child-name templating, but the house rule says child copy goes through host.t. Not changed (about 200 strings; would need a hook in each visual).
Try step: going Back to a solved try step remounts TrySlot idle with Siguiente enabled, so the exercise can be skipped on revisit. Acceptable for a lesson, but a solved state would be more honest.
SubCheckVisual (w4 sub-check) shows no check panel on phase 0 while its text describes the check. Small copy/visual mismatch, left as is.

Carry/column visuals were only reviewed in the gallery at the 560px-era size; real-route screenshots at 1180x820, 820x1180 and 1280x800 for each lesson (especially the 4-digit carry, 4-digit borrow and galera on portrait) were NOT captured. Layout at those sizes is unverified.
Galera draws a rule under the divisor as well as under the dividend; this is a stylised casita, not the classic single-rule layout. Design call for the integrator.
host.reportAttempt from TrySlot still needs the integrator to confirm that lesson practice attempts should update mastery (from the earlier open issue).

Tests check that SafeVisual crashes are caught by console.error spy (now asserted in every Season 1 lesson playthrough), but they do not check the visual's on-screen content beyond rendering a non-null container.
contractRequests: Confirm that lesson 'try' attempts should call host.reportAttempt and therefore update mastery (TrySlot.tsx). No change was made to the contract.
notesForOtherModules: LessonPlayer props and exports are unchanged. The fixes are internal to the lesson module.
